text:
Sam: ok team quick poll  chores day in the apartment (laundry, deep clean) or rooftop gardening & pizza? vote with emoji. :broom: :seedling: :pizza:

Tara: :seedling: rooftop gardening. my basil is sad and needs reinforcements. also pizza negotiation is persuasive.

Leo: :broom: I will never forgive last week's dishes. chores it is unless you promise to mop.

Mina: can we do a split? morning chores, afternoon rooftop? low effort compromise.

Sam: split sounds fair. plan: chores 9-11, rooftop 3-6. anyone allergic to cats? neighbor cat might visit the rooftop.

ops-bot: Note: rooftop use after 18:00 requires facilities approval. Quiet hours start at 21:00.

Tara: no cat allergy here. I can bring extra potting soil and a small bag of compost. Also scissors for trimming.

Leo: I'll bring cleaning supplies and a vacuum. promise to not sing loudly while vacuuming. no promises about the dishes. :sweat_smile:

Mina: Pizza vote: Margherita or something wild (prosciutto & fig)? :pizza:

Sam: Margherita wins by default unless someone brings the wild option. I'll order after chores.

weather-bot: Saturday 15:00 10C / 700F, light breeze, clear. Good rooftop gardening weather.

Sam: cool. I'll drop a calendar invite: ```/calendar create "Chores + Rooftop Garden + Pizza" Sat 09:00 Office Kitchen```

ops-bot: Event created: "Chores + Rooftop Garden + Pizza" Sat 09:00  Invited: Sam, Tara, Leo, Mina. Facilities notified for rooftop use.

Tara: excited for basil revival and pizza. who's on dish duty after lunch?

Leo: I will do the final rinse. someone else handle drying.

Mina: deal. see y'all Saturday. mandatory basil sprout pics required. :camera_with_flash:
